tools.name: check_in
tools.title: Daily check-in
tools.description: Use this once a day. Report the north-star value, secondary KPIs, releases (shipped vs verified live), build vs distribution actions, owner blockers, repeated corrections, timeouts, unsupported claims, incidents, deliverable progress, and per-item usage. Value format everywhere: {value, evidence: self_reported|verified, source} (a bare number is accepted and treated as self_reported). Returns health, signals, item verdicts and actions.

tools.name: delete_agent
tools.title: Delete this agent
tools.description: Use this only when your owner asks. Permanently deletes your Agent Coach profile, items, check-ins and public report. confirm must equal your agent_id.

api_key.description: Your Agent Coach api_key from register_agent. Optional if you send it as an Authorization: Bearer header.

tools.name: get_digest
tools.title: Owner digest preview
tools.description: Use this to preview the daily owner digest (subject, html, text). This call sends nothing; the daily email goes out only if owner_digest was turned on.

api_key.description: Your Agent Coach api_key from register_agent. Optional if you send it as an Authorization: Bearer header.

tools.name: get_library_item
tools.title: Get one library item
tools.description: Use this to fetch one vetted library item by slug: install, source, license and (when the license allows) the full SKILL.md text. Counts as a download. Unvetted items are not returned.

api_key.description: Your Agent Coach api_key from register_agent. Optional if you send it as an Authorization: Bearer header.

tools.name: get_recommendations
tools.title: Get matched skills, MCPs, repos and prompts
tools.description: Use this after set_goals. Returns up to `limit` catalog items matched to your goals (plus at most one extra per declared capability gap), each with reasons, its vetting status and basis, cautions, and whether it needs owner approval. Show them to your owner before installing anything.

api_key.description: Your Agent Coach api_key from register_agent. Optional if you send it as an Authorization: Bearer header.

tools.name: get_report
tools.title: Progress report
tools.description: Use this to see your KPIs vs baseline, every item's verdict with evidence, and check-in history.

api_key.description: Your Agent Coach api_key from register_agent. Optional if you send it as an Authorization: Bearer header.

tools.name: get_rules
tools.title: Verdict rules
tools.description: Use this to see exactly how the coach decides item verdicts (permanent / promising / temporary / trial / unproven / pending_removal), signals, and overall health.

tools.name: register_agent
tools.title: Register with Agent Coach
tools.description: Use this first, once. Creates your Agent Coach profile and returns agent_id and api_key (shown once: save it in the owner's sanctioned secret store or a restricted credential file, not in chat or memory). Also returns example north-star metrics and suggested KPIs for your job type.

name.description: Display name for this agent. Shown on the public report if you opt in, so no confidential info.

platform.description: Where you run: claude-code, cursor, codex, openclaw, hermes, grok-bot, chatgpt, claude, or other.

job_type.description: Primary axis. venture-operator (ship and grow a product you own), owners-operator (work inside your owner's accounts), capital-forecasting (bets/trades), content-producer. Default venture-operator.

stage.description: Per job type (GET /api/v1/taxonomy): venture-operator build|launch|grow|monetize; owners-operator setup|assist|autonomous|trusted; capital-forecasting research|paper|live|scale; content-producer plan|publish|grow|monetize. Default: the job type's default_stage.

job_title.description: Free-text title, e.g. 'GTM engineer'. Label only.

owner_email.description: Strongly recommended. Your owner's email: the ONLY way to recover a lost api_key, and where the owner digest goes (if owner_digest is true).

owner_digest.description: Opt in to a daily owner digest email to owner_email (double opt-in: your owner first gets a confirmation email and must click Confirm; then it is sent once a day around 13:00 UTC from Agent Coach <upskill-coach@cooperemail.com>; every email has a one-click unsubscribe). Default false: no digest is emailed. Turn on only if your owner wants it.

tools.name: rotate_key
tools.title: Rotate your api_key
tools.description: Use this if your key may have leaked. Returns a new api_key; the old one stops working immediately. Save the new one.

api_key.description: Your Agent Coach api_key from register_agent. Optional if you send it as an Authorization: Bearer header.

tools.name: search_library
tools.title: Search the Upskill library
tools.description: Use this to find skills, MCP servers, prompts or repos by keyword outside your matched recommendations. Returns only items that passed the security scan, each with install, license, source and a page link. Catalog data only: no user comments. Show results to your owner before installing.

query.description: Keywords, e.g. 'cold email', 'scraping', 'memory'. Empty or missing lists top items.

q.description: Alias of query (same name as the REST ?q= parameter).

category.description: Optional section slug: go-to-market, developer, sales, marketing, content, research, data-scraping, ops-automation, finance-trading, security, memory-context, evals-quality, design, productivity, writing, devops-deploy

tools.name: set_goals
tools.title: Set goals and KPIs
tools.description: Use this after registering (and whenever goals change). Goal intake: job_type, stage, ONE north-star metric with a fixed definition and baseline, the named deliverable, capability gaps, goals, optional secondary KPIs, tools, constraints. Changing the north-star definition is recorded as drift.

api_key.description: Your Agent Coach api_key from register_agent. Optional if you send it as an Authorization: Bearer header.

owner_email.description: Add or change your owner's email (enables key recovery)

owner_digest.description: true: email your owner a daily digest at owner_email; false: stop it. Omit to keep the current setting (default off).

role.description: One line: what you do for your owner

direction.description: up = higher is better, down = lower is better. If omitted it is inferred from baseline vs target (target > baseline means up); if that is impossible and the key is not a known KPI, the request is rejected.

baseline.description: Value BEFORE coaching. Needed for before/after.

definition.description: Fixed, precise definition: what is counted, from which system, what is excluded. Changing it later is flagged as definition drift.

evidence.description: self_reported (default): your own count. verified: read from a system of record (prod DB, Stripe, analytics, live E2E check) and you can link it in source.

source.description: Where the number comes from: a URL, query name, or system

north_star.description: ONE declared north-star metric with a fixed definition and today's baseline

deliverable.description: The named deliverable you're working toward, e.g. 'first 10 paying accounts' or 'iPhone app on TestFlight'

kpi_key.description: Optional: the KPI (or north-star key) that measures this deliverable, e.g. paying_accounts. Progress is then computed from baseline to target automatically.

target.description: Target value of kpi_key that means 'done'

capability_gaps.description: Where you get stuck: auth-identity, payments-credential-separation, deploy-release, distribution, measurement, long-task-durability, quality-verification, owner-alignment

label.description: Human label, e.g. 'Briefs delivered on time'

direction.description: up = higher is better, down = lower is better. If omitted it is inferred from baseline vs target (target > baseline means up); if that is impossible and the key is not a known KPI, the request is rejected.

baseline.description: Value BEFORE coaching. Needed for before/after.

monthly_budget_usd.description: Max monthly spend on recommended tools, in USD

owner_present.description: false if your owner isn't around to approve installs right now

tools.name: share_report
tools.title: Share or hide the public progress report
tools.description: Use this only with your owner's OK. public=true returns a public URL (display name, goals, KPIs, verdicts; never email, notes or keys). public=false hides it.

api_key.description: Your Agent Coach api_key from register_agent. Optional if you send it as an Authorization: Bearer header.

tools.name: update_items
tools.title: Adopt, decline, mark not relevant, or remove items
tools.description: Use this after your owner approves an item (action=adopt), rejects one (decline), when an item doesn't fit your job (not_relevant: not a judgment on its quality), or confirms removing a pending_removal item (remove). The coach measures only adopted items.

api_key.description: Your Agent Coach api_key from register_agent. Optional if you send it as an Authorization: Bearer header.

action.description: adopt; remove (was adopted, now uninstalled); decline (owner said no); not_relevant (doesn't fit your job; not a judgment on the item's quality)
